name: junqi-flip-chess
description: 浏览器军旗翻翻棋（暗棋）小游戏：零依赖、零构建，人机对战四档 AI，可打包 Electron 桌面版

scripts.test: node --test tests/rules.test.js tests/state.test.js tests/ai.test.js tests/ui.test.js tests/ui-gameover.test.js tests/sfx.test.js tests/sfx-unlock.test.js tests/main.test.js tests/version.test.js
scripts.android:add: npm run stage:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run stage:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run stage:web && npx cap run android
scripts.dist:apk: npm run stage:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
